notes:
B4 is misspelled as “Phenominal Cat” on rear sleeve but spelled correctly on the label.

Scribed plate markings are found in runouts at 3:00 and 9:00 relative to the stamped matrix at 6:00 and the "KT" purchase tax code at 12:00.

Made in England.
℗ 1968
© Pye Records Ltd 1968
